scope: Corollary 11.3 (Relative approximate Nash hardness) of the manuscript “The PCP-for-PPAD conjecture: a quasilinear reduction” (preprints/The-PCP-for-PPAD-conjecture-a-quasilinear-reduction-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 136 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a7ab4d86183890be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 132. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are a fixed rational 0 < εr < 1 and a fixed polynomial pr such that the following search problem is PPAD-complete under deterministic polynomial-time many-one search reductions. Given an explicitly encoded rational bimatrix game (A, B) with A ≥ 0, B ≤ 0, and complete binary length L, find a rational mixed-strategy profile of total encoding length at most pr(L) satisfying (11.2).
